summary.zh: Vault 自动创建目录下线两个低频通道：Cloudflare（需先手动持有 parent token，对新用户是先有鸡还是先有蛋）与 Google AI Studio（gcloud 安装+登录的前置成本高，且新项目存在被 Google 自动封禁的风险）。对应平台改为手动录入 Key（附控制台链接），自动创建平台数 33→31。
summary.en: Two low-frequency channels are retired from the vault auto-create directory: Cloudflare (requires a pre-existing parent token — a chicken-and-egg for new users) and Google AI Studio (high setup cost of gcloud install + login, plus Google's auto-deny risk on brand-new projects). Both platforms remain available via manual key entry with a console link; supported auto-create platforms go from 33 to 31.

highlights.zh: 自动创建平台列表精简为 31 个纯浏览器通道：移除 Cloudflare（api 模式）与 Google AI Studio（gcloud CLI 模式）入口，降低初始用户的选择成本与理解负担。
highlights.en: The auto-create list is streamlined to 31 pure-browser channels: the Cloudflare (api mode) and Google AI Studio (gcloud CLI mode) entries are removed, reducing choice overload for first-time users.

highlights.zh: 两个平台的 Provider 本身不受影响：Google AI Studio 仍可手动粘贴 Key 使用（含模型发现），Cloudflare 相关云同步后端也原样保留；仅自动创建入口下线，服务代码保留便于日后恢复。
highlights.en: The providers themselves are untouched: Google AI Studio still works with a manually pasted key (model discovery included) and Cloudflare sync backends remain; only the auto-create entries are retired, with service code retained for a future re-enable.

highlights.zh: 文档数字全量对齐：README 对比表、中英文手册第 4 章统一为 31（顺带修正了中英文原本就不同步的问题——中文写 33、英文写 31）。
highlights.en: Docs numbers aligned everywhere: the README comparison table and both manual languages now consistently say 31 (also fixing a pre-existing zh/en mismatch — 33 in Chinese vs 31 in English).
